As the autumn wind gradually rises, the daughter of Jianghu gathers together, the autumn wind sends the cool, the wine wafts the fragrance, and the Jianghu of chivalry shakes up the waves again!
The Steam platform has also ushered in the highly anticipated autumn sale, the so-called warrior, has opened the autumn promotion!

For players who like Wuxia culture, the Steam Fall Sale is undoubtedly an opportunity not to be missed, join us and write your own chivalrous legend together! In this autumn, let the so-called swordsman take you to appreciate the real world of martial arts, feel the blood of the lake!

Because the current stage of the game framework is complete, mainly update the plot. The last time I updated one of the "Four ancient schools", from the feedback of players, I always feel not happy. notes.title: Update Plan
notes.content:
【 Current framework 】
Open Wuxia world, not only all NPCS can interact, almost all objects on the map have added dynamic code, wind, frost, rain and snow, four seasons change. These dynamics can transform all kinds of interesting stories and interactions, such as:
1. On rainy days, the stone walls are wet, showing the magic.
2. "Next autumn, when the maple leaves are red, we will fight on the peak of Huashan Mountain!"
3. "Everyone", people in rivers and lakes, can fight with him, borrow money, give gifts, fortune telling... Ha ha ha, many functions I find interesting, put on first.
4. "Every tree" is not simply a map, but the four seasons change, there is snow covered, it will blossom and bear fruit, it will be broken by you, you can use it as a weapon, you can also put these things into medicine!
5. There are many more

In this framework, you can combine a variety of martial arts stories, interesting characters, so that players in this lake, have the ultimate sense of bringing!

【 Future Plan 】
Since the game has just been launched, there are many deficiencies, after continuous updates, although a lot of bugs and optimization problems have been solved, but it is still not enough, we have to do better!!
0. 【 Repair and improvement 】

1. 【 Collection of Stories 】 :
Goal: Strengthen the reminder of the context of the branch line and the main line, and enhance the sense of engagement.
Reason: Before for the feeling of super freedom, I made an innovative side system (no taskbar, the map happens in real time), but many reminders are not in place, I intend to make a system to greatly enhance the sense of fun.

2. 【 Strongest Pharmacist 】
Goal: Potion refining system, can be refined into more effects of medicine, and additional bring more stories, interactive fun, treasure revenue.
Reason: This alchemy system, which took half a year to innovate, has too few early reminders, too little feedback, and is too hardcore. I want it to be silky and fun.

3. 【 Characters and map 】
Goal: Add more current NPC stories, including map guides
Reason: There are now 391 NPCS (in a broad sense: including small animals, organs, people, names and last names 200+), 300+ maps, many players have not played, I guide too little.

4. 【 Main story 】
Objective: To prepare the story of the second "Four Ancient Schools" at the same time, which is expected to be half a year +
Reason: The current is the first part [light and dark], some of the characters of the second part have already appeared.

5. Gameplay depth
Goal: Players propose various details of the gameplay, consider in-depth.
Welcome: We welcome your comments and thank you for your interaction to make the game better.

Thank you to all players for your support!! We will continue to work hard to bring happiness to everyone and live up to everyone's expectations!

【当前大框架】
开放武侠世界，不光是所有NPC 可以交互，几乎地图上所有物件都加了动态代码，风霜雨雪，四季变换。这些动态，就可以变幻出各种有趣的故事和交互，比如：
1。下雨天，石壁湿润，显现神功。
2。“明年秋天，枫叶红时，在华山绝顶峰决斗！”
3。《每一个人》，江湖中人，都可以和他打斗，借钱，送礼，算命。。。。哈哈哈，很多功能我觉得有趣，就先放上去了。
4。《每一棵树》，不简单是一张贴图，而是四季变幻，还有下雪覆盖，还会开花结果，还会被你掰断树枝，可以当成武器，也可以把这些东西入药炼丹！
5。还有很多

在这个框架下，可以结合各种各样的武侠故事，奇趣的人物，让玩家在这个江湖中，拥有极致的带入感！

【未来计划】
由于游戏刚刚上线，有很多不足，经过连续更新，虽然解决了很多bug和优化问题，但还是不够，我们要做得更好玩！！！
0。【修复与完善】

1。【故事集】：
目标：加强支线和主线来龙去脉的提醒，提升代入感。
原因：之前为了超级自由的感觉，做了创新的支线系统（没有任务栏，地图实时发生），但很多提醒不到位，我打算做成一个系统来大幅提升玩赏感。

2。【最强药师】
目标：丹药炼制系统，可炼成更多效果的丹药，并且附加带来更多故事，交互乐趣，宝物收益。
原因：这个炼丹系统，花了半年时间创新打造的，前期提醒太少，反馈太少，过于硬核。我要改得丝滑有趣好玩。

3。【人物和地图】
目标：增加更多当前NPC的故事，包括地图引导
原因：现在NPC有391（广义的：包括小动物，机关人啥的，有名有姓200+），地图300+，很多玩家还没玩到，是我引导太少。

4。【主线故事】
目标：同时准备第二部【四大古派】的故事，预计半年+
原因：当前是第一部【重明复暗】，有些第二部的人物已经出场。

5。游戏性深入
目标：玩家提出的各种细节玩法，考虑深入。
欢迎：欢迎大家多提意见，感谢大家的互动，让游戏变得更好。

感谢所有玩家的支持！！！我们会不断努力，给大家带来开心快乐，不辜负大家的期待！

notes.title: Delay Release
notes.content:
Postponing Game release    We learned the sad news today that due to the untimely passing of one of our country's leading comrades, the release date of our game has been postponed. 
   Express our deep condolences on the passing away of our leading comrade. The leading comrade is one of the outstanding leaders of our country and has made great contributions to the development of the country and the well-being of the people. His passing is not only a national loss, it is a sorrow for all of us. At this time, we are united in mourning his passing and send our deepest condolences and support to his family and loved ones. 
   The decision to postpone the release of the game is a difficult one, but we will make adjustments and arrangements as soon as possible to make good preparations for the release of the game, and repay the expectation and support of our players with a good work.
